title: The Secret Life of Bees
author: Sue Monk Kidd
summary: In South Carolina in 1964, a lonely teenager runs away with her family's housekeeper and ends up at the home of three beekeeping sisters. Under their roof she starts to learn about her mother and herself.
readIf: you want a warm, lyrical coming-of-age story about women who raise and protect each other.
skipIf: you want a deep treatment of the civil rights era; it is mostly a personal story set against it.

pairings.reason: Another story of women and race in the 1960s American South, with similarly warm ensemble relationships.
A classic Southern story told by a child narrator, with weightier themes of injustice.
Another girl abandoned by her family finds support in nature and a few kind people.
